entities.name: City
entities.description: Former survivor of Duskmourn, strongest forager of the carnival, who joined the Cult of Valgavoth and betrayed the carnival to the House.

entities.name: Dawn
entities.description: Survivor City wished to bring into the cult; the only one to survive his attack on her camp.

entities.name: Rill
entities.description: Forager injured by a Wickerfolk and later captured by the Cult.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane, also called the House, hunting its survivors.

entities.name: The carnival
entities.description: Safe zone of survivors betrayed by City.

entities.name: Valley of Serenity
entities.description: Place City offered Dawn to join him.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Creatures City set on Dawn's camp.

events.summary: City, Rill and Sunset return from a run where Rill was hurt by a Wickerfolk; City reveals he joined the Cult of Valgavoth, betraying the carnival.
events.quote: he revealed that He had aligned himself with Duskmourn and joined the Cult of Valgavoth

events.summary: Dawn flees, leaving Rill and Sunset to be captured by the Cult.
events.quote: Dawn bolted, leaving Rill and Sunset to be captured by the Cult.

events.summary: City tracks Dawn to an attic safe zone and has Razorkin kill everyone but her, offering her a choice to join him.
events.quote: He set his Razorkin on the camp, killing everyone but Dawn
